title: 第17章 妖王寿宴第18章 斩杀魔狼王
slug: 成为女帝炉鼎我踏上了无敌路
content_zh:
这是一个宽阔的山洞，里面有许多人类建筑，如房间，桌椅，石床等等，山洞中央有一个小型舞台，上面有一群颇有姿色的女子在唱歌跳舞。
舞台前左右三方围满了各种妖兽，还有一些人类，大家觥筹交错，手舞足蹈，很是开心。
而在舞台最高位处有三个位置。
居中仰躺着一头肥硕高大的独角魔狼，满身肥肉，足有一两吨重，犹如一座肉山。
左边坐着一名干瘦中年人，气息修长，目光炯炯有神，一看就知道是高手。
左边站着一只四臂猿猴，高足有五米，给人一种很强的压迫感。
在山洞的空地上有一口大锅，热气腾腾，里面全是人类躯体、骨骸；大锅旁的桌上摆放着许多杯子，里面全部盛满了鲜血。
这是一场人肉盛宴！
看到这血腥而残忍的场景，李凡睚眦欲裂，咬牙切齿道：“这群畜生真该死！”
沈向武拳头紧握，浑身颤抖，眼里满是杀意。
“杀光它们，一个不留！”
李易怒喝，手持玄器长剑径直冲了过去，剑光一闪，察觉洞口有异样正出来查看的妖兽，便身首异处。
接着他杀入妖兽群，在真气的催动下，玄器长剑锋利无比，将这些皮坚肉厚的妖兽一个个砍翻在地，死于非命。
李凡犹如猛虎下山，几个箭步便冲入了妖兽群，拳出如龙，掌若刀剑，顷刻间便击毙了两头低阶狼妖。
“杀！”
沈向武见李易两兄弟杀妖如此迅速，受到激励，也跟着冲向妖兽。
“敌袭，敌袭。”
洞口附近的妖兽哇哇大叫，吓得屁滚尿流，疯狂逃窜。
洞府内大乱，妖兽纷纷扭头望来，舞台上的女子吓得花容失色，四处逃命，可舞台四面都是狰狞可怕的妖兽，吓得又退回舞台中央，蹲在地上，瑟瑟发抖。
“孙城主，怎么回事？那人手持的可是你临荒城守城军的灵器配刀。”

舞台上方，魔狼王扭头凝视干瘦中年人，眼神严厉，带着怒火，它的子孙并不多，刚刚就被杀了四五头。
“魔狼王，是我的失职，我去将他抓过来，凌迟处死谢罪。”
孙城主一脸惶恐，当即飞奔而下，直奔沈向武而来。
“猿将，下去将那两个小畜生抓过来，本王要生吃了他们。”
魔狼王对右边的四臂猿猴下令道。
“是。”
四臂猿猴一个腾跃，瞬息百丈，杀向距离最近的李易。
“你们继续给我唱歌跳舞，谁再乱跑，本王就生吃了谁。”
魔狼王坐起来，浑身肥肉乱颤，瞪大了眼睛，满脸凶狠。
一群歌女舞女战战兢兢起身，又开始唱跳，但这一次明显没有之前表现好，声音带着畏惧，动作很小心。
舞台下，鲜血飙飞，一头头妖兽死在李易，李凡两兄弟的攻击之下。
“沈向武，本城主待你不薄，你特么居然背叛我。”
孙城主怒不可遏，腾空而来，对清秀士兵猛地拍出一掌，一只巨大的光掌冲出，瞬息而至。
沈向武聚起全身真气于大刀上，劈向巨大光掌，却被击得吐血飞起，跌落在地面。
舞台上方，魔狼王冷声道：“沈城主，这个叛徒交给本王拷问，你去将那个使拳头的壮汉抓来，他是修行肉身的炼体士，血肉对本王是大补。”
“好。”
content_en:
This is a wide cave with many human buildings in it, such as rooms, tables, chairs, stone beds, etc. There is a small stage in the center of the cave, with a group of pretty women singing and dancing on it.
The three sides in front of the stage were surrounded by various monsters and beasts, as well as some humans. They all drank, danced and were very happy.
There are three positions at the top of the stage.
In the center lay a fat and tall one-horned demon wolf, covered in fat and weighing one or two tons, like a mountain of meat.
Sitting on the left is a thin middle-aged man with a slender breath and piercing eyes. You can tell he is a master at a glance.
There is a four-armed ape standing on the left, which is five meters high, giving people a strong sense of oppression.
There is a large cauldron in the open space of the cave, which is steaming hot. It is full of human bodies and bones. There are many cups on the table next to the cauldron, all of which are filled with blood.
This is a feast of human flesh!
Seeing this bloody and cruel scene, Li Fan was so jealous that he gritted his teeth and said, "These beasts deserve to die!"
Shen Xiangwu clenched his fists, his whole body was shaking, and his eyes were filled with murderous intent.
"Kill them all, leaving no one behind!"
Li Yi yelled angrily, and rushed over with a mysterious long sword in his hand. With a flash of sword light, he noticed that there was something strange at the entrance of the cave, and there was a monster coming out to check, and his head was in a different place.
Then he rushed into the group of monster beasts. Under the urging of his true energy, the mysterious long sword was extremely sharp and chopped down these tough-skinned monster beasts to the ground one by one, dying to their deaths.
Li Fan descended the mountain like a tiger. He rushed into the group of monsters in a few steps. His fists were like dragons and his palms were like swords. He killed two low-level wolf monsters in an instant.
"Kill!"
Shen Xiangwu was inspired by seeing the two brothers Li Yi killing the monster so quickly, and he also rushed towards the monster.
"Enemy attack, enemy attack."
The monsters near the entrance of the cave screamed, were so frightened that they pissed themselves, and ran away like crazy.
There was chaos in the cave, and the monsters turned to look at them. The woman on the stage was so frightened that she turned pale and ran for her life. However, the stage was surrounded by ferocious monsters. She was so frightened that she retreated to the center of the stage, squatting on the ground, trembling.
"City Master Sun, what's going on? That man is holding the spiritual weapon and sword of your Linhuang City defenders."
Above the stage, the Demon Wolf King turned to stare at the thin middle-aged man, his eyes stern and angry. He didn't have many descendants, and he had just killed four or five of them.
"Demon Wolf King, it was my dereliction of duty. I will go and capture him and execute him Lingchi to apologize."
City Lord Sun had a look of panic on his face and immediately rushed down, heading straight for Shen Xiangwu.
"General Ape, go down and capture those two little beasts. I will eat them alive."
The Demon Wolf King ordered the four-armed ape on the right.
"Yes."
The four-armed ape jumped up to 100 feet in an instant and charged towards the nearest Li Yi.
"You continue to sing and dance for me. If anyone runs around again, I will eat him alive."
The Demon Wolf King sat up, his body trembling with fat, his eyes widened and his face full of ferocity.
A group of singers and dancers stood up timidly and began to sing and dance again, but this time they were obviously not as good as before. Their voices were frightened and their movements were very careful.
Under the stage, blood flew out, and monsters died one after another under the attacks of brothers Li Yi and Li Fan.
"Shen Xiangwu, this city lord treats you well, why the hell did you betray me?"
City Lord Sun was furious, soared into the air, slapped the handsome soldier, and a huge light palm rushed out, arriving in an instant.
Shen Xiangwu gathered all his true energy on the big sword and struck at the huge light palm, but was hit so hard that he vomited blood and flew up, falling to the ground.
Above the stage, the Demon Wolf King said coldly: "City Lord Shen, this traitor will be handed over to me for torture. You go and capture the strong man who uses fists. He is a body refiner who practices the flesh. Flesh and blood are a great supplement to me."
"Okay."
